en.name: Overhead Press
setup: Set the bar in a rack at upper chest height.
Grip it just outside your shoulders and step back with feet hip-width apart.
Rest the bar on your upper chest with elbows slightly in front of the bar.
execution: Squeeze your glutes and press the bar straight up, moving your head back out of its path.
Push your head through once the bar passes your forehead and lock out overhead.
Lower the bar back to your upper chest.
mistakes: Leaning back and turning it into an incline press.
Pressing the bar forward around the face.

en.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
setup: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Bend your elbows slightly and lean forward a little.
execution: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are level with your shoulders.
Lower slowly to your sides.
mistakes: Swinging the weight with the hips.
cues: Pour out a jug at the top

en.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
setup: Set a bench upright and sit with your back against it.
Bring the dumbbells to shoulder height with palms facing forward.
execution: Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to shoulder height.
mistakes: Arching the back away from the pad.

en.name: Face Pull
setup: Attach a rope to a pulley at face height.
Grip the ends with thumbs pointing back and step away until your arms are straight.
execution: Pull the rope toward your face, splitting the ends apart.
Finish with your hands beside your ears and elbows high.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Leaning back to move heavy weight.
Letting the elbows drop below the hands.

en.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
setup: Stand tall holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Brace your core and keep a slight bend in the elbows.
execution: Raise the dumbbells straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly.
mistakes: Rocking the body to swing the weight.

en.name: Arnold Press
setup: Sit on an upright bench holding dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Keep your elbows in front of your body.
execution: Press the dumbbells up while turning your palms to face forward.
Finish with straight arms overhead.
Reverse the turn as you lower.

en.name: Reverse Pec Deck
setup: Sit facing the pad of the pec deck with the handles set to the back position.
Grip the handles with straight arms at shoulder height.
execution: Sweep your arms back until they line up with your body.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Squeezing the shoulder blades hard so the traps take over.

en.name: Machine Shoulder Press
setup: Adjust the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Sit with your back against the pad.
execution: Press the handles up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly to shoulder height.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the seat.

en.name: Cable Lateral Raise
setup: Set a pulley at the lowest position and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, arm in front of your hips.
execution: Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly across your body.
mistakes: Leaning away a lot to cheat the weight up.

en.name: Barbell Upright Row
setup: Hold the bar with an overhand grip about shoulder width.
Stand tall with the bar resting on your thighs.
execution: Pull the bar up close to your body, leading with the elbows.
Stop when your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Pulling the bar to the chin with a narrow grip.
en.safety: Stop at shoulder height; pulling higher pinches the shoulder in many people.

en.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Reverse Fly
setup: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
Let the dumbbells hang under your chest with soft elbows.
execution: Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your back.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Squeezing the shoulder blades instead of moving the arms.

en.name: Pike Push-Up
setup: Start in a push-up position and walk your feet in until your hips are high.
Your body should form an upside-down V.
execution: Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor in front of your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Turning it into a regular push-up by dropping the hips.

en.name: Band Pull-Apart
setup: Hold a light band in front of your chest with straight arms.
Grip it about shoulder width.
execution: Pull the band apart until it touches your chest.
Return slowly.

en.name: Push Press
setup: Set up as for an overhead press with the bar on your upper chest.
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
execution: Dip a few centimetres by bending the knees, torso upright.
Drive up through the legs and press the bar overhead in one motion.
Lower the bar back to your chest.
mistakes: Dipping too deep or leaning forward in the dip.
Pressing before the legs finish driving.

en.name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
execution: Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders.
mistakes: Leaning back to finish the rep.
Pressing the dumbbells forward instead of up.

en.name: Landmine Press
setup: Stand facing the end of a landmine bar in a staggered stance.
Hold the end of the bar at your shoulder with one hand.
execution: Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder.

en.name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
setup: Place an upright bench under the bar so it lowers just in front of your face.
Sit and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
execution: Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
Lower it to chin height.
mistakes: Setting the bench so the bar hits the face or chest.

en.name: Handstand Push-Up
setup: Kick up into a handstand with your heels against a wall.
Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
execution: Lower your head to the floor under control.
Press back up to straight arms.
en.safety: Put a folded mat under your head and build up from pike push-ups.
cues: Head and hands form a triangle

en.name: Plate Front Raise
setup: Stand tall holding a weight plate by its sides at your thighs.
Brace your core.
execution: Raise the plate in front of you to eye level.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Cable Front Raise
setup: Attach a straight bar or rope to a low pulley.
Stand facing away from it, holding the attachment between your legs.
execution: Raise your arms in front to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Machine Lateral Raise
setup: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot.
Place your arms against the pads.
execution: Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
setup: Sit on an upright bench inside a rack with the bar at about head height.
Grip slightly wider than your shoulders and unrack.
execution: Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press it overhead until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Lowering the bar behind the neck.

en.name: Cable External Rotation
setup: Set a pulley at elbow height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle in the far hand with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked to your side.
execution: Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly, keeping the elbow pinned.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Letting the elbow drift away from the side.
Using a weight so heavy the torso twists.

en.name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
setup: Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder so it rests on the back of your forearm.
Stand tall with glutes and core tight.
execution: Press the kettlebell overhead, turning the palm forward as it rises.
Lower it back to the rack position.

en.name: Cable Reverse Fly
setup: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and cross the cables, holding the left cable in the right hand and vice versa.
Stand in the middle with your arms straight in front.
execution: Pull your hands out and back until your arms line up with your body.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a row.

en.name: Band External Rotation
setup: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand side-on to it.
Hold it in the far hand with your elbow bent 90 degrees at your side.
execution: Rotate your forearm outward against the band.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Moving the elbow off the side.

en.name: Band Overhead Press
setup: Stand on the middle of a band with feet hip-width apart.
Hold the ends at your shoulders with palms forward.
execution: Press your hands overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to your shoulders.
mistakes: Letting the band pull the hands forward.

en.name: Band Face Pull
setup: Anchor a band at face height.
Hold it with both hands, palms down, arms straight.
execution: Pull the band toward your face, spreading your hands apart.
Finish with elbows high and hands beside your ears.

en.name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
setup: Place your feet on a bench or box and your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands back until your hips are over your shoulders.
execution: Lower your head toward the floor in front of your hands.
Press back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Letting the hips drift back down.

en.name: Band Lateral Raise
setup: Stand on the middle of a band and hold the ends at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
execution: Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band.

en.name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
setup: Lie on your side holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Bend the elbow 90 degrees and rest it on your side, forearm across your belly.
execution: Rotate the forearm upward as far as is comfortable while the elbow stays on your side.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Lifting the elbow off the body.

en.name: Cable Upright Row
setup: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley.
Stand close and hold it with an overhand grip about shoulder width.
execution: Pull the bar up along your body until your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Prone Y Raise
setup: Lie face down with your arms overhead in a Y shape, thumbs pointing up.
Rest your forehead on a folded towel.
execution: Lift your arms off the floor by drawing your shoulder blades down.
Hold briefly and lower.
mistakes: Lifting the chest high off the floor.

en.name: Wall Handstand Hold
setup: Place your hands about a hand's length from a wall.
Walk your feet up the wall until your body is nearly vertical, chest facing the wall.
execution: Push the floor away and hold your body in a straight line.
Walk down carefully when your form breaks.
en.safety: Learn to come down safely before holding for time.

en.name: Dumbbell Upright Row
setup: Stand tall with dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Keep the palms facing your body.
execution: Pull the dumbbells up, leading with the elbows, to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Prone T Raise
setup: Lie face down with your arms straight out to the sides, thumbs up.
Rest your forehead on a folded towel.
execution: Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly and lower.

en.name: Z Press
setup: Sit on the floor inside a rack with your legs straight in front of you.
Unrack the bar at your upper chest with a grip just outside your shoulders.
execution: Press the bar overhead without leaning back.
Lower it to your upper chest.
en.safety: Use safety arms set just below shoulder height in case you miss a rep.

en.name: Prone W Raise
setup: Lie face down with your elbows bent and pulled in so your arms form a W.
Rest your forehead on a folded towel.
execution: Lift your elbows and hands off the floor by squeezing the shoulder blades together and down.
Hold briefly and lower.

en.name: Band Front Raise
setup: Stand on the band and hold the ends in front of your thighs.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
execution: Raise your arms in front to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Letting the band snap the arms down.

en.name: Incline Dumbbell Y Raise
setup: Set a bench to a low incline and lie face down on it.
Hold light dumbbells with your arms hanging and thumbs pointing up.
execution: Raise your arms forward and out into a Y until they line up with your body.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Using weights heavy enough to make you swing.

en.name: Band Upright Row
setup: Stand on the middle of a band.
Hold the ends in front of your thighs.
execution: Pull your hands up along your body until the elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Suspension Trainer Y Raise
setup: Face the anchor holding the handles with straight arms.
Walk your feet forward and lean back, body straight.
execution: Raise your arms up and out into a Y, pulling your body up with them.
Lower slowly back to the lean.

en.name: Suspension Trainer Reverse Fly
setup: Face the anchor holding the handles in front of your chest with straight arms.
Lean back with a straight body.
execution: Open your arms out to the sides into a T, pulling your body up.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Reverse Snow Angel
setup: Lie face down with your arms by your sides, palms down.
Lift your arms and chest slightly off the floor.
execution: Sweep your arms in a wide arc overhead, keeping them off the floor.
Sweep them back to your hips.
cues: Arms hover all the way round

en.name: Wall Isometric Shoulder Abduction
setup: Stand side-on to a wall with your arm at your side and the back of your wrist against the wall.
Bend the elbow slightly.
execution: Press your arm outward into the wall as if raising it to the side.
Hold steady pressure for the set time.
mistakes: Leaning the body into the wall.

en.name: Freestanding Handstand
setup: Warm up the wrists and shoulders.
Place your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers spread.
execution: Kick up into a straight handstand away from any wall.
Balance by pressing through your fingers and palms.
Come down by stepping one leg down or rolling out.
mistakes: Arching the back into a banana shape.
en.safety: Learn to bail out by turning sideways before practising away from a wall.
